text:
:= by
  intro x
  have h1 : 0 < x := lt_trans (lt_iff_pos_left.2 (le_of_gt hx)) (lt_zero_neg (neg_pos.mpr hx))
  let n := ⌊x⌋₊
  have h2 : n ≤ x := le_floor_iff.1 (le_rfl)
  have h3 : n ≥ 1 := le_antisymm (le_zero (real.floor_le x)) (le_of_gt hx)
  have h4 : Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x ≥ Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x :=
    add_nonneg (le_refl _) (le_zero_real_sqrt h1)
  have h5 : ↑n.primeCounting ≤ Real.log 4 * x / Real.log √x + √x :=
    primeCounting_le_log_4_div_log_sqrt_x_add_sqrt_x n h2 h3 h4
  exact h5
